sites.evidence_type: topology inference (C-terminal snorkel — no accessible terminus)
sites.rationale: C-terminus not extracellular (topology 'I' at residue L) and no accessible N-terminus — C-terminal snorkel presents the tag on the surface via a TM-snorkeling linker (fallback: no natively accessible terminus)

literature_notes: ANKH is a 12-pass transmembrane protein with six short extracellular loops (42–48, 106–131, 180–190, 262–275, 347–372, 422–427). Every ledger entry involves a terminal tag: L1/L2/L3 place a C-terminal FLAG after residue 492 (intracellular span 451–492); L4/L5 use p3xFLAG-CMV-10, which appends 3xFLAG before residue 1 (intracellular span 1–20); L6/L7 fuse eGFP to either the N-terminus (intracellular) or C-terminus (intracellular) of full-length ANKH. All six extracellular loops are short (6–26 aa) and none is addressed by any ledger insertion. Because no ledger line grounds a tag in any extracellular position, zero sites qualify. The F377del and S375del CMD mutations noted in L5 fall in the TM helix 373–383 and reduce protein levels markedly; they are recorded in other_positions as function-abrogating. The N- and C-terminal intracellular tags are also recorded there.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal FLAG tag (stop codon ablated, FLAG added to 3′ end); residue 492 lies in the intracellular C-terminal span 451–492; surface display confirmed but tag faces cytoplasm.
N-terminal 3xFLAG via p3xFLAG-CMV-10 vector; residue 1 lies in the intracellular N-terminal span 1–20; tag faces cytoplasm.
F377del CMD mutant expressed as 3xFLAG construct showed markedly lower protein levels than wild-type ANK, indicating disrupted folding or trafficking; residue 377 falls in TM helix 373–383.
S375del CMD mutant expressed as 3xFLAG construct showed markedly lower protein levels than wild-type ANK; residue 375 falls in TM helix 373–383.
